title: Boundary rectifiability for finite-mass integer multiplicity currents in ℝ^P
statement: Assume DeformationTheorem (Simon 5.3) and IntegralityOfWeakLimits (Simon 8.2), as frozen. Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let X ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity with M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞. Then ∂X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P) is an integer multiplicity current.
lean_statement: DeformationTheorem → IntegralityOfWeakLimits → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → IsIntegerMultiplicity X.boundary
